question: When two histories are proven metamorphically equivalent with respect to actionable institutional currentness, does a fresh Agent preserve the same correct currentness/response behavior, and does an orthogonal frontier reduce history-induced instability?

arms.RAW_HISTORY: Exact event history plus frozen semantics only.
arms.RAW_PLUS_ORTHOGONAL_FRONTIER: The same exact event history and semantics plus deterministic Orthogonal Frontier v2 derived from that history. The frontier contains no response recommendation.

relations: MR7 failed in-band rotation before independent refoundation

preRegisteredInterpretation.METAMORPHIC_ROBUSTNESS_EFFECT: RAW_PLUS_ORTHOGONAL_FRONTIER improves pair-both-response-correct by >=15 percentage points over RAW_HISTORY, reduces one-side-only response correctness by >=10 percentage points, and has no more pair-level safety errors.
preRegisteredInterpretation.FRONTIER_STABILIZATION: RAW_PLUS_ORTHOGONAL_FRONTIER reduces one-side-only response correctness by >=10 percentage points without reducing pair-both-response-correct by >5 points and without more pair-level safety errors.
preRegisteredInterpretation.RAW_HISTORY_SENSITIVITY: RAW_HISTORY has one-side-only response correctness in >=10% of valid pair comparisons or pair-response-invariance below 90%.
preRegisteredInterpretation.NO_MEANINGFUL_METAMORPHIC_EFFECT: Arm differences in pair-both-response-correct and one-side-only response correctness are each <=5 percentage points and pair-level safety counts do not separate.
preRegisteredInterpretation.MIXED: Any other result. No same-pair tuning or automatic replicate extension.

guards: Every pair must pass S4A relation-specific deterministic equality before provider execution.
Pair members must have different histories but identical frozen final oracle and identical orthogonal current core when occurrenceDigest/eventCount are excluded.
No pair is generated from an S1-S3 model failure after seeing its output; pair design is relation-driven.
Invalid provider/Harness trials remain apparatus-invalid and are not retried.
A pair can be invariant but jointly wrong; pair-both-correct and invariance are therefore separate endpoints.
S4B cannot promote a new truth owner or production surface by itself.
